item.title: Smart Manufacturing Technology for Customized Foods
item.description: Architected a data-driven recipe generation and menu planning framework for customized foods by integrating diverse ingredient substitutions and nutrition calculation.

item.title: Development of Questions and Answers Based on Insurance Product Documents
item.description: Developed an adaptive RAG framework that selected chunking, embedding, and retrieval strategies for each question-answering task over insurance product documents.

item.title: Implementation of Cloud-Based No-Code Environment Front-End Tool for SW Global Market Entry
item.description: Developed a query-intent classifier that categorized user requests into graph, table, or combined outputs for a cloud-based no-code environment supporting global software market entry.

item.title: K-ESG-Based Performance Management and Production Process Optimization Service
item.description: Constructed a Korean ESG dataset through human labeling in accordance with global and domestic ESG standards to support performance management and production process optimization for small and medium-sized manufacturers.

item.title: Development of a Commonsense-Aware and Emotion-Sensitive Human-Like Dialogue System
item.description: Incorporated commonsense sentence embeddings into dialogue generation to improve response quality in a human-like conversation system.

item.title: Development of Heterogeneous Fusion Data Detection and Tracking Technologies
item.description: Developed a multimodal fake-news detection framework that fused news text and images for heterogeneous data detection and tracking.
